scope: Argentina medical discovery — National University of Córdoba Faculty of Medical Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: UNC's Faculty of Medical Sciences reports receipt of CONEAU Resolution RESFC-2024-353-APN-CONEAU#MCH, accrediting Medicine for six years, the maximum available period.
UNC states that Medicine was called for CONEAU reaccreditation under national 2021 resolutions.
CONEAU's WFME-recognition medical-school list includes Universidad Nacional de Córdoba.

holdReasons: No current official Medicine programme duration, curriculum, fees, language-of-instruction or admissions/international-candidate route was established.
A complete clinical-placement, accommodation and international student-support evidence packet was not completed.
The current accreditation evidence must not be expanded into graduate-practice claims without relevant regulatory evidence.
